question: 已知数列 $\{x_n\},\{y_n\},\{z_n\}$ 满足 $x_0=-1,y_0=0,z_0=2$ 且 $x_n=-2x_{n-1}+2z_{n-1},y_n=-2y_{n-1}-2z_{n-1},z_n=-6x_{n-1}-3y_{n-1}+3z_{n-1}$。记 $\alpha_n=(x_n,y_n,z_n)^T$，写出 $\alpha_n=A\alpha_{n-1}$ 的矩阵 $A$，并求 $A^n$ 及 $x_n,y_n,z_n(n=1,2,\dots)$.
